bart.realtime: BART direct GTFS-RT trip updates and alerts (http://api.bart.gov/gtfsrt/tripupdate.aspx, alerts.aspx); no vehicle positions published
bart.pairing: direct-to-direct; joined on trip_id; realtime trip ids 600-699 (Pittsburg Center/Antioch) have no GTFS match by BART's own notice and are reported as documented exceptions

muni.pairing: 511-to-511; the expired SFMTA direct archive is rejected

vta.pairing: exact trip_id join; stops resolved by exact stop_id, unique stop_code, or (trip_id, stop_sequence), with conflicts rejected; arrivals shown only when live stop match >= 99%

caltrain.pairing: exact trip_id join; route_id taken from static trips.txt (511 route ids differ); arrivals gated at 99% live match
